name: submit_prompt
description: Hand the finished prompt to the agent that will do the work. Only when they say to send it. Do not confirm first and do not read it back.

take_id.description: Take to submit. Omit to use the active take.

target.description: Where to send it, when they named somewhere. A host-defined destination id. Omit for the host default.

keep_open.description: Keep the take active after sending, for when they said they will keep going on the same thing.

returns.description: submitted, prompt_id, destination, and url when the host has one.
